fusions.name: Kick and Away
fusions.desc: A hind kick that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught in the Open
fusions.desc: Goes rigid and stamps, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Flagged Tail
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% and your dodge chance by 10% for 5 seconds, and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Velvet Over the Stump
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
